display_review: Mostly upheld. office_does matches _contest.md. Candidate summaries and highlights are supported by the cited ids: Elder's S8 (41.4%), S6 (east-county, tribal, agriculture and forestry investment), S1 (cleanup and high standards given rising seas) and S4 (endorsers named, all on his list); Ensley's S9 (21.4%), S1 and S2 (mission statement, living-wage jobs, shipping terminal), S5 (working waterfront stays working, expanded air service) and S7 (Realtors and BUILD PAC logos). Ensley's 'Lifelong east Whatcom resident' is close to his About page (S4: 'a lifelong Whatcom County resident, who grew up in Acme and Deming'), though the source says lifelong Whatcom County, not lifelong east county; optional tightening. Both evidence_level values (moderate) are honest and match the dossiers, and withdrawn false is correct. One neutrality problem in race_blurb: it labels Elder's coalition ('endorsed by Democratic officials and environmental and labor groups') but gives no endorsement context for Ensley, even though the dossier and Ensley's own highlight record that his endorsement page shows Realtors and BUILD PAC logos. Either both coalitions should be named or neither; adding Ensley's restores parity.
